description:
Replace the embedded contents of a Smart Object layer from an image file. Preserves transforms, warps, and Smart Filters on the layer.

Users often say: replace smart object, swap mockup screen, relink embedded file.

Use when: updating a mockup or template Smart Object with a new asset file.
Do NOT use when: the target is not a Smart Object — convert first or use photoshop_place_image.
Do NOT use for linked Smart Objects that need Relink to File — this replaces embedded contents.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { layer_name, file_path } }.
Preconditions: Smart Object layer active or named; file_path must exist (absolute). Side effects: replaces embedded pixels.

document_id.description: Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. Send null to use the active document. A number activates that document before the tool runs.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the replacement image file (JPEG, PNG, PSD, etc.)

layer_name.description: Optional exact Smart Object layer name. Default: active layer.

name: photoshop_replace_smart_object_contents
